name: Rail Planner
description: 在 Xaero 世界地图上直接选线、画铁路，按铁路工程口径把折线圆角化成切线—圆曲线—切线，像素化到方块，并统计长度、坡度、隧道/桥、材料与行车时间；关掉地图后同一条线会立在三维世界里（设计标高、地形、填挖立柱，隧道蓝桥橙，V 开关 X 穿山）。装到服务端后按 UUID 分玩家保存，本地保留一份、服务端存一份，两边不一致时逐条问你要留哪边。\n\nDraw a railway right on the Xaero world map: pick points and the polyline is filleted into tangent – circular curve – tangent, snapped to blocks, with length, gradient, tunnels and bridges, material counts and running time. Close the map and the same line stands in the 3D world — design elevation, terrain, cut-and-fill posts, tunnels in blue and bridges in orange, V to hide, X to see through terrain. Install it on the server as well and lines are stored per player by UUID, one copy locally and one on the server; when the two disagree it asks you line by line which one to keep.
